svg.title: Flat world map marking Baytown, Texas and Bahadurgarh, Haryana
svg.desc: Neutral-colored countries on an equirectangular world map; two orange pins identify Metal Foil Inc. inventory and the Jindal Metals and Alloys mill. Neither country is specially colored.
svg.text: MAP: EQUIRECTANGULAR PROJECTION · NEUTRAL LAND COLOR · NOT A POLITICAL BOUNDARY MAP
